name: Diadora S.p.A.
via: Geox S.p.A. (71.16% held by LIR S.r.l., the Moretti Polegato family holding)
note: Italian sportswear maker founded 1948. Geox S.p.A.'s half-year 2026 financial report names Diadora S.p.A. as an affiliated company of the Geox group, whose controlling shareholder is LIR S.r.l. (Moretti Polegato family). Norwegian distribution runs through Ultimate Nordic AS (formerly Wenaas Nordic AS, Brønnøysund orgnr 910 123 068), a subsidiary of Dalema Gruppen; Dalema's ownership is not stated by its own site.
